# Integrations

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Make

- **What it is:** Whatsable modules in Make: triggers for incoming WhatsApp messages, actions that send templates, schedule follow-ups and update contacts, and a delivery status search. Coexistence is supported.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins create the API key it needs.
- **Where:** Integrations > Make
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/make.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/make

## Zapier

- **What it is:** WhatsAble triggers and actions in Zapier: run Zaps on WhatsApp messages, send templates and media, schedule follow-ups, update contacts and check delivery status. Coexistence is supported; you keep the WhatsApp Business app on your phone.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins create the API key it needs.
- **Where:** Integrations > Zapier
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/zapier.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/zapier

## n8n

- **What it is:** Connect Whatsable with n8n. Run workflows on WhatsApp messages, send templates and media, schedule messages and update contacts with the verified Whatsable node. Coexistence is supported; you keep the WhatsApp Business app on your phone.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins create the API key it needs.
- **Where:** Integrations > n8n
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/n8n.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/n8n

## Pipedrive

- **What it is:** Install WhatsApp Automation Pipedrive & AI by Whatsable from the Pipedrive Marketplace, log WhatsApp conversations as activities, create persons, deals and leads, and send WhatsApp messages from deals and persons.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** An owner or an admin connects it; each Pipedrive user authorizes once.
- **Where:** Integrations > Pipedrive > Connect Pipedrive organization
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/pipedrive.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/pipedrive

## monday.com

- **What it is:** Connect a Monday.com account so WhatsApp conversations land on board items, and Monday.com workflows can send WhatsApp templates.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** An owner or an admin in Whatsable, with a monday.com admin or member.
- **Where:** Integrations > Monday.com > Connect Monday.com
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/monday.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/monday

## Salesforce

- **What it is:** Install the WhatsAble Chat package in Salesforce, paste a Whatsable API key, and show the WhatsApp chat for one phone number on a Lead, Contact, or Opportunity.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. It is a paid add-on on Pro and Agency, for each organization that connects it; it can be set up and tested during the trial. Work, Growth, Bulk Message and the Free plan cannot add it.
- **Who can do it:** An owner or an admin creates the key; a Salesforce admin installs the package.
- **Where:** Integrations > Salesforce > Install in Salesforce
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/salesforce.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/integration/salesforce
